description: This file defines the user-related API routes for the backend, including registration, login, profile fetching, and profile updating. It sets up Express routes and links them to controller functions, with some routes protected by authentication middleware.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration logic, invoked on POST /api/users/register

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, invoked on POST /api/users/login

methods.name: profile
methods.description: Fetches the authenticated user's profile, invoked on GET /api/users/profile

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Allows updating the user's profile, invoked on PATCH /api/users/profile
